# Become a Poll Worker

## Sherry Poland

### Director

Board of Elections

4700 Smith Rd

Cincinnati, Ohio 45212

[Apply Online](https://votehamiltoncountyohio.gov/become-poll-worker/)

## Why become a poll worker?

The Hamilton County Board of Elections is always looking for citizens to work the polls.  Poll workers would be working inside voting locations ensuring that all voters have the ability to exercise their right to vote.  If you are interested in becoming a poll worker please [click here to apply](https://votehamiltoncountyohio.gov/become-poll-worker/).  Follow the link below to see why others have chosen to become a poll worker.

## [Why do I work the Polls?](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NRwm1Q7CbTU)
